reply.text: {"say":"Traps and neck, built for size: heavy shrugs and an upright pull lead, then all three neck directions on the machines to thicken it from every side.","title":"Traps & Neck","days":[{"name":"Traps & Neck","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-shrug","sets":4,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause at the top, shoulders to ears"},{"key":"dumbbell-shrug","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Straight up and down, no rolling"},{"key":"cable-upright-row","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lead with the elbows"},{"key":"neck-extension-machine","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Slow and controlled, full range"},{"key":"neck-flexion-machine","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Tuck the chin, no jerking"},{"key":"machine-neck-lateral-flexion","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Each side, smooth tempo"}]}],"unmet":[]}
